description: Verified Japanese and English prints for Hisuian, Electric combo, and N decks; exact source URLs and artwork retained.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Spiny Rush
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Proud Fangs
attacks.effect: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Sharp Poison
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 5 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

attacks.name: Quill Sting
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.effect: Draw a card.

meta.effect: During this turn, your Fighting Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . During your turn, you may discard 2 cards from your hand (except Grant) to put this card from your discard pile back into your hand. (This effect does not count as using your Supporter for turn.)

attacks.name: Spell of Failure
attacks.effect: At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Call Home
attacks.effect: Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.

meta.effect: Put up to 3 Pokémon with "Hisuian" in their name from your discard pile into your hand.
Search your deck for an evolution card, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
The attacks of the Pokemon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokemon V (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
Draw 2 cards. If your Active Pokémon has "Hisuian" in its name, draw 2 more cards.
Whenever any player puts a Basic Pokémon from their hand onto their Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent while this card is attached to an evolved Pokémon (except Pokémon with a Rule Box) , this card provides 3 Energy of any type.

attacks.name: Togedash
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent doesn't take a prize card if this Pokémon is Knocked Out during their next turn.

attacks.name: Pikastrike
attacks.effect: If your Dedenne used Dedeshort during your last turn, this attack does 180 more damage.

attacks.name: Pekobomber
attacks.effect: You can only use this attack if your Dedenne used Dedeshort during your last turn. This attack does 60 damage to all of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Sudden Change
abilities.effect: This Pokémon can use the attacks from Basic Pokémon (except Pokémon with a Rule Box) in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy for each attack.)

attacks.name: Dedeshort
attacks.effect: You can only use this attack if your Togedemaru used Spikedash during your last turn. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

meta.effect: Both players put their hand cards face down, shuffle them and put them on the bottom of their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards and your opponent draws 4 cards.
Ask your opponent if each player should take a Prize card. If yes, both players take a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards.

You can use this card only use if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining. Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.
Each player switches their Active Pokemon with 1 of their Benched Pokemon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokemon, that player doesn't switch Pokemon.)

Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and choose up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy you find there. Attach them to your Benched Lightning Pokémon in any way you like, and shuffle the remaining card back into your deck.
Put up to 2 Pokémon with 90 HP or less from your discard pile into your hand.
The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to gets +50 HP.

attacks.name: Back Draft
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage for each Basic Energy card in your opponent's discard pile.

attacks.name: Flamebody Cannon
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Powerful Rage
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

meta.effect: N's Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.
Discard the top 6 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are basic Energy cards, attach them to 1 of your Benched Dragon Pokémon.
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

attacks.name: Thieving Swipe
attacks.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rampaging Thunder
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon.
Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
